title: ccp16_utilization.json: Incorrect expected sf value contradicts oracle_provenance
description: Line 125: Vector 'utilization_high_with_sf7_baseline' expects sf=10, but per the oracle_provenance algorithm ('if utilization > 150: SF += 2; if utilization > 200: return (SF, false)'), assigned_sf=7 with utilization=201 should yield sf=9 (7+2=9), not sf=10. The description claims '+1 for util>200' but this rule is not documented in oracle_provenance and contradicts vector 'utilization_201_tx_blocked' which correctly applies only +2 for the same utilization value.
close_reason: Fixed: corrected test vector sf expectation from 10 to 12 per spec (return 12, false when util>200). Also fixed Rust implementation which incorrectly added +1 instead of hardcoding SF=12. Updated oracle_provenance to clarify hardcoded SF=12 behavior.
